cc:Work.dc:title: Part - LaserCalibration
cc:Work.dc:description:
Measure kerf and effective material thickness in one cut
Everything on this sheet is drawn at its nominal size with no burn correction, whatever burn is set to.
**Kerf coupon:** a square hole of known size. Measure the square that drops out and the hole it leaves with calipers. The square shrinks and the hole grows by one kerf, so kerf = (hole - square) / 2 and the burn setting to use is half of that.
**Thickness gauge:** a comb of notches labelled with their drawn width. Slide a scrap of your sheet into them and note the label of the tightest notch it still goes into. The real slot width is the label plus one kerf.
Feed both results into `scripts/calibrate` to write them into machine_profile.yaml.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes LaserCalibration Command line short: boxes LaserCalibration
